prompt:
One craftsperson actively repairs a damaged wooden chair: a previously loose leg is being fixed securely with a screwdriver, the chair stands straight again, a few small wood shavings below. One cohesive improvement scene, no before-after panels. Exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
Use attached reference ONLY for style: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, rounded simplified 2D forms, restrained cartoon shading. Single compact composition filling 80-90% of square, fully inside frame. 512x512 RGBA PNG, genuinely transparent background and gaps. No text, labels, border, logo, watermark.
en: Repairing the loose leg brings amelioration to the damaged chair.
ja: ゆるんだ脚を固定し、傷んだ椅子を使える状態に改善している。
